Body.Content:
Recent updates to Azure Machine Learning will give data scientists and AI developers complete control of the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle on a scalable, trusted platform that will bring AI to everyone.

Benefits will include:

·        Integrated intelligent data preparation.

·        Better collaboration, version control, and reproducibility.

·        Increased rate of experimentation.

·        Fast and easy model deployment.

·        Data-driven model management.

·        Open, flexible, extensible machine learning platform.

·        Training and deployment options in the cloud, on-premises, and edge.

Try it for free.

Learn more about Azure Machine Learning.
